LAKESIDE MEDICAL CENTER
Discharge Instructions
Patient: Sam Okafor
Discharge date: October 27, 2026
Diagnosis: Community-acquired pneumonia
Doctor: Dr. Priya Patel, Internal Medicine
Your medicines
1. Amoxicillin 500 mg capsule: take 1 capsule by mouth 3 times a day for 7 days.
Finish all of it, even if you feel better.
2. Acetaminophen 500 mg tablet: take 1 to 2 tablets every 6 hours as needed for fever.
Do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours.
Activity and care at home
Rest and drink plenty of fluids. No driving while you feel very tired.
Use your incentive spirometer 10 times every hour while awake.
Follow-up appointment
See Dr. Priya Patel on November 6, 2026 at 10:30 AM.
Lakeside Clinic, 2nd floor. Phone: (555) 013-4400.
WHEN TO GET HELP
Call 911 right away if you have trouble breathing, chest pain, or lips turning blue.
Call your doctor if your fever is over 101 F for more than 2 days, or you cannot keep
medicines down.
